Package com.saicone.delivery4j

Interface Broker.Logger

All Known Implementing Classes:
Log4jLogger, Slf4jLogger
Enclosing class:
Broker
public static interface Broker.Logger
Logger interface to print messages about broker operations and exceptions.
Unlike normal logger implementations, this one uses numbers as levels:
1 = ERROR / SEVERE
2 = WARNING
3 = INFO
4 = DEBUG INFORMATION
